chapters.label: The Held Gaze
chapters.text: The Held Gaze gathers portraits where the subject keeps her interior life intact. Irina lets faces stay private and luminous at once: eyes turning toward us, hands shielding light, skin and leaves and fabric becoming a threshold rather than a pose.

chapters.label: Body as Element
chapters.text: Body as Element follows figures through water, stone, shadow, cloth, and weather. Gesture becomes landscape here; the body is not displayed so much as returned to the world that shaped it.

chapters.label: Earth & Dream
chapters.text: Earth & Dream widens the field into rain, desert, sea, night plants, mineral color, and the charged stillness of travel. These photographs carry the same intimacy as a portrait, only the face has become place.

chapters.label: The Accord
chapters.text: The Accord holds two people inside one atmosphere: couples, vows, forests, shorelines, and the small negotiations of closeness. Irina watches for the private language between bodies before it becomes performance.

chapters.label: Afterimage
chapters.text: Afterimage keeps what remains after presence moves through: rooms, relics, fruit, museum ground, a flower in the dark, a road of trees, a portrait softened into memory. Nothing here is empty; everything is still giving off light.
